name: Bodyweight Squat
form_cues: Feet shoulder-width and toes slightly out | Sit back and down with your chest up | Knees follow the toes and heels stay flat

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
form_cues: Hold one dumbbell against your chest | Elbows point down between your knees | Stay tall and push the floor away
note: Free Exercise DB lists the kettlebell version only

name: Barbell Back Squat
form_cues: Bar sits on your upper back and never on your neck | Brace your belly before you go down | Drive up through the middle of your feet

name: Barbell Front Squat
form_cues: Bar rests on your front shoulders with elbows high | Keep your torso upright all the way | Stand up with control

name: Leg Press
form_cues: Feet shoulder-width on the platform | Lower until your knees are about 90 degrees | Keep your lower back against the pad

name: Smith Machine Squat
form_cues: Place your feet slightly in front of the bar | Lower with your chest up | Push up without locking the knees hard

name: Wall Sit
form_cues: Back flat on the wall and thighs parallel to the floor | Knees above the ankles | Breathe steadily while you hold

name: Jump Squat
form_cues: Squat down then jump straight up | Land softly on the whole foot | Reset your stance before the next jump

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
form_cues: Wide stance with toes turned out | Hold one dumbbell between your legs | Knees track over your toes as you lower

name: Standing Calf Raise
form_cues: Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet | Pause at the top | Lower slowly until your heels nearly touch the floor
note: Tagged knee only because the squat pattern rule requires it

name: Dumbbell Lunge
form_cues: Take a long step and lower straight down | Front knee stays over the ankle | Push back to standing through the front heel

name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
form_cues: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor | Keep your torso upright | Step through into the next lunge

name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
form_cues: Step back and lower under control | Front heel stays down | Push through the front foot to return

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
form_cues: Place your whole foot on the bench | Stand up using the front leg only | Lower slowly without dropping

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
form_cues: Rear foot rests on a bench behind you | Lower straight down on the front leg | Keep your weight over the front heel

name: Side Lunge
form_cues: Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip | Keep the other leg straight | Push off to return to the middle

name: Barbell Lunge
form_cues: Bar sits on your upper back | Step forward and lower under control | Drive back up and keep your chest tall

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
form_cues: Push your hips back with soft knees | Slide the bar down your thighs | Keep your back flat and stand by squeezing your glutes

name: Barbell Deadlift
form_cues: Bar starts over your mid-foot | Brace your belly and keep your back flat | Push the floor away and stand tall

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
form_cues: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs | Hinge at the hips with a flat back | Squeeze your glutes to stand

name: Kettlebell Swing
form_cues: Hike the bell back then snap your hips forward | Arms guide the bell and do not lift it | Stand tall at the top without leaning back

name: Glute Bridge
form_cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat | Lift your hips until your body is a straight line | Squeeze your glutes and lower slowly

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
form_cues: Upper back rests on a bench | Drive your hips up with your chin tucked | Pause and squeeze at the top

name: Barbell Good Morning
form_cues: Bar sits on your upper back | Push your hips back with a flat spine | Stand up by driving your hips forward

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
form_cues: Hinge forward as your back leg lifts behind you | Keep your hips square to the floor | Use a light weight until balance is steady

name: Superman Hold
form_cues: Lie face down and lift arms and legs together | Keep your neck long and look at the floor | Hold briefly and lower with control

name: Push-Up
form_cues: Hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line | Lower your chest to the floor | Press up without sagging your hips

name: Incline Push-Up
form_cues: Hands on a bench with your body in a straight line | Lower your chest to the edge | Press back up with control

name: Knee Push-Up
form_cues: Knees on the floor and hands under your shoulders | Keep a straight line from knees to head | Lower your chest and press up

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
form_cues: Hands close under your chest with elbows tucked | Keep your body in a straight line | Lower slowly and press up

name: Barbell Bench Press
form_cues: Feet planted and shoulder blades pinched on the bench | Lower the bar to your mid-chest | Press up in a straight line

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
form_cues: Shoulder blades pinched on the bench | Lower the weights beside your chest | Press up until your arms are straight

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
form_cues: Set the bench at a gentle angle | Lower to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked | Press up and keep your back on the pad

name: Dumbbell Fly
form_cues: Arms slightly bent like hugging a barrel | Open wide until you feel a chest stretch | Bring the weights together over your chest

name: Cable Chest Fly
form_cues: Slight bend in the elbows throughout | Bring your hands together in front of your chest | Return slowly and keep your shoulders down

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
form_cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent | Lower until your upper arms touch the floor | Press up and keep your wrists straight

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
form_cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height | Press forward until your arms are straight | Return slowly and keep tension on the band

name: Bench Dip
form_cues: Hands on the edge of a bench and hips close to it | Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees | Press up and keep your shoulders down

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
form_cues: Elbows pinned to your sides | Push down until your arms are straight | Let the handle rise slowly

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
form_cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands | Lower it behind your head by bending only the elbows | Extend back up without arching your back

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
form_cues: Lie on the bench with the weights above your chest | Bend only at the elbows to lower beside your head | Extend back up and keep your upper arms still

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
form_cues: Start with the weights at shoulder height | Press straight up without arching your back | Lower slowly back to your shoulders

name: Barbell Overhead Press
form_cues: Grip just outside your shoulders | Squeeze your glutes and press the bar overhead | Move your head through at the top

name: Pike Push-Up
form_cues: Hips high so your body forms an upside-down V | Lower the top of your head toward the floor | Press back up through your shoulders

name: Arnold Press
form_cues: Start with palms facing you at chest height | Rotate your palms out as you press up | Reverse the motion on the way down

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
form_cues: Soft elbows and a slight lean forward | Lift the weights out to the sides to shoulder height | Lower slowly without swinging

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
form_cues: Lift the weights in front to shoulder height | Keep your torso still | Lower slowly

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
form_cues: Sit with your back against the bench | Lower the bar to chin height | Press up without locking out hard

name: Pull-Up
form_cues: Hang with your shoulders pulled down | Pull your chest toward the bar | Lower all the way with control
note: Their level is beginner; ours is intermediate on purpose

name: Chin-Up
form_cues: Palms face you and hands shoulder-width | Pull until your chin passes the bar | Lower slowly to a full hang

name: Lat Pulldown
form_cues: Grip wider than your shoulders and sit tall | Pull the bar to your upper chest | Let it rise slowly with your shoulders staying down

name: Resistance Band Pulldown
form_cues: Anchor the band high above you | Pull your elbows down toward your ribs | Return slowly and keep your chest up
note: Needs a high anchor point such as a door frame

name: Dumbbell Pullover
form_cues: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell | Keep your arms slightly bent as you lower it behind you | Pull it back over your chest

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
form_cues: One hand and knee on the bench with a flat back | Pull the weight toward your hip | Lower until your arm is straight

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
form_cues: Hinge forward with a flat back | Pull the bar to your lower ribs | Lower with control and keep your neck neutral
note: Their level is beginner; ours is intermediate on purpose

name: Seated Cable Row
form_cues: Sit tall with a slight bend in the knees | Pull the handle to your belly | Squeeze your shoulder blades and return slowly

name: Inverted Row
form_cues: Hang under a low bar with your body straight | Pull your chest to the bar | Lower with control
note: Use a low bar or a sturdy table

name: Resistance Band Row
form_cues: Sit tall with the band around your feet or anchored ahead | Pull your elbows back past your ribs | Return slowly

name: Cable Face Pull
form_cues: Set the rope at face height | Pull toward your forehead with elbows high | Keep your wrists straight and return slowly

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
form_cues: Hinge forward with a flat back | Lift the weights out to the sides | Lower slowly without swinging

name: Band Pull-Apart
form_cues: Hold the band in front of you at chest height | Pull it apart until your arms are out wide | Return slowly

name: Reverse Snow Angel
form_cues: Lie face down with arms by your sides | Sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead | Keep your neck long and your thumbs up

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
form_cues: Elbows stay at your sides | Curl the weights up to your shoulders | Lower slowly without swinging

name: Hammer Curl
form_cues: Palms face each other throughout | Curl up and keep your elbows still | Lower with control

name: Barbell Curl
form_cues: Grip shoulder-width and stand tall | Curl the bar up without swinging | Lower slowly

name: Resistance Band Curl
form_cues: Stand on the band with feet hip-width | Curl your hands to your shoulders | Lower slowly and keep tension

name: Dumbbell Shrug
form_cues: Hold the weights at your sides | Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears | Lower slowly without rolling them

name: Plank
form_cues: Elbows under your shoulders and body in a straight line | Squeeze your glutes and belly | Breathe steadily and do not let your hips sag

name: Side Plank
form_cues: Elbow under your shoulder and feet stacked | Lift your hips so your body forms a line | Hold and keep your hips from dropping

name: Dead Bug
form_cues: Lie on your back with arms up and knees over your hips | Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly | Keep your lower back pressed to the floor

name: Bird Dog
form_cues: On hands and knees with a flat back | Reach the opposite arm and leg out | Move slowly without twisting your hips

name: Crunch
form_cues: Knees bent and hands by your head or across your chest | Lift your shoulders off the floor | Lower slowly without pulling on your neck

name: Bicycle Crunch
form_cues: Lift your shoulders and bring opposite elbow and knee together | Move slowly and keep your lower back down | Do not pull on your neck

name: Reverse Crunch
form_cues: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips | Curl your hips off the floor | Lower slowly with control

name: Lying Leg Raise
form_cues: Lie on your back with legs straight | Lift them up until they point to the ceiling | Lower slowly and keep your lower back down

name: Hanging Knee Raise
form_cues: Hang with your shoulders pulled down | Raise your knees toward your chest | Lower slowly without swinging

name: Russian Twist
form_cues: Sit leaning back with your chest up | Rotate your shoulders from side to side | Keep your feet down if your back feels tight

name: Mountain Climber
form_cues: Hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line | Drive your knees toward your chest in turn | Keep your hips low and breathe

name: Hollow Body Hold
form_cues: Lie on your back and lift shoulders and legs slightly | Press your lower back into the floor | Hold and breathe

name: Cable Pallof Press
form_cues: Stand side-on to the cable with the handle at your chest | Press your hands straight out | Resist the pull and do not rotate

name: Farmer's Carry
form_cues: Hold a heavy weight in each hand | Walk tall with your shoulders back | Take steady steps and keep your ribs down

name: Suitcase Carry
form_cues: Hold one weight at your side | Walk tall without leaning toward the weight | Switch hands after each set

name: Banded Lateral Walk
form_cues: Band around your thighs and a slight squat | Step sideways keeping tension on the band | Keep your toes pointing forward

name: Clamshell
form_cues: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together | Lift your top knee without rolling back | Lower slowly
note: Strengthening move filed under mobility because the pattern list has no better fit

name: Glute Kickback
form_cues: On hands and knees with a flat back | Kick one heel up toward the ceiling | Lower slowly and do not arch your back

name: Jump Rope
form_cues: Small hops on the balls of your feet | Turn the rope with your wrists | Land softly and keep your knees slightly bent

name: Treadmill Walk
form_cues: Walk tall with a natural arm swing | Start slow and raise the speed gradually | Do not hold the rails if you can avoid it

name: Treadmill Run
form_cues: Land softly under your hips | Keep a relaxed upper body | Warm up and cool down with a walk

name: Stationary Bike Ride
form_cues: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom | Pedal at a steady pace | Keep your shoulders relaxed

name: Jumping Jacks
form_cues: Jump your feet wide as your arms rise overhead | Land softly on the balls of your feet | Keep a steady rhythm

name: Burpee
form_cues: Squat down and place your hands on the floor | Step or jump back to a plank | Return and stand or jump up

name: High Knees
form_cues: Run in place lifting your knees to hip height | Stay on the balls of your feet | Pump your arms and keep your chest up

name: Skater Jump
form_cues: Leap sideways from one foot to the other | Land softly and bend your knee | Swing your arms for balance

name: Brisk Walk
form_cues: Walk fast enough that talking is a little hard | Stand tall and swing your arms | Wear supportive shoes

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
form_cues: On hands and knees with hands under your shoulders | Round your back then arch it slowly | Move with your breath

name: Child's Pose
form_cues: Sit back toward your heels with arms reaching forward | Relax your head and shoulders | Breathe slowly

name: World's Greatest Stretch
form_cues: Step into a long lunge with hands on the floor | Rotate your chest and reach one arm up | Switch sides slowly

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
form_cues: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward | Tuck your pelvis and shift forward | Hold without arching your back

name: Thoracic Rotation
form_cues: On hands and knees with one hand behind your head | Rotate your elbow toward the ceiling | Keep your hips still

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
form_cues: Place one heel forward with the toes up | Hinge at the hips with a flat back | Hold gently and never bounce

name: Wall Ankle Mobilization
form_cues: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward | Drive your knee over your toes keeping the heel down | Return and repeat slowly

name: Band Shoulder Pass-Through
form_cues: Hold the band wide in front of you | Lift it overhead and behind you with straight arms | Use a wider grip if you feel pinching
